image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a cream-colored ceramic teacup and saucer. The cup features a dark brown, abstract drip-like pattern on its side. The lighting is warm and dramatic, casting strong shadows. The handle is visible on the right, appearing smooth and integrated. The rim is rounded. The saucer sits beneath the cup on a dark wooden surface.
